{"text":"Several things could trip you up when comparing Norway orders and returns year on year.

The biggest one is that online sales to Norway stopped on 4 August 2026 after a new customs rule, so Norway orders fell to almost nothing from that date. A year-on-year comparison for any period after that will show a large drop that reflects the stop, not customer behaviour. Fewer orders after 4 August do not mean fewer customers [itm_norwaystop].

The Norway returns definition changed on 28 April 2026. Returns now count only refunds that reached the customer's bank, while cancelled refunds were counted before. Earlier weeks therefore read about 4 percent higher, so comparing across that date mixes two definitions. This item's check date has passed, so it may be out of date [itm_ra39ow6c].

Orders in Norway have a payment-scope conflict. One rule says Norway orders count only card and cash payments, with store credit and gift cards left out [itm_giftcardonly]. Another says Norway orders include store credit and gift cards, converted to euros at the daily rate [itm_giftstorecredit]. The owner of Sales marked these two as disagreeing, so I can't say which applies. Your Norway order totals will differ depending on which one you follow, and a lower figure than the shop report is not necessarily missing data [itm_giftcardonly].

Norway's VAT rule ran from 3 August 2025 to 5 June 2026, and it taxed discounts as part of the price. Welcome discounts were cut in Norway during that time, so discount cost there is lower for those months. Lower conversion in those months is not proven to come from the smaller discounts [itm_7ini5esz].

Marketing's Norway spring campaign ran from 24 March to 9 May 2026, with ads paused by the regulator on 9 May. Return on ad spend after that date is not the campaign's result [itm_eprlkrz2].

Both metrics are defined in euros at the daily rate. Orders exclude cancelled orders and failed payments, and Returns are dated by when the payment provider confirmed the refund [itm_eprlkrz2] (definitions: Orders and Returns, source Cube).

I searched for orders and returns in Norway across all dates and kinds, and read 21 published context items you may read. I did not find a single item that covers both metrics together for Norway, so the points above come from separate items.","calls":[]}
